t.d: London trade in domestic and marine barometers, with Italian immigrant makers dominant by 1840 and Hatton Garden firms leading the Victorian era.
t.tech: mercury tube filling, carved and veneered cases, silvered engraved dials, aneroid movements
t.auth: maker's name and address engraved on the dial or register plate; dates from address directories

t.d: Tradition of brass astrolabes and treatises in the Islamic world, from al-Fazari in the 8th century to universal and geared astrolabes, later carried on in India.
t.tech: cast and engraved brass, stereographic projection of plates, pierced rete
t.auth: signed or dated inscriptions; plate latitudes for named places

t.d: Latin astrolabe tradition after Gerbert of Aurillac brought the instrument north of the Pyrenees, with treatises by Chaucer and Stöffler.
t.tech: engraved brass plates and rete, Latin scales
t.auth: Latin inscriptions and star names, maker's signature, plate latitudes
